_note: Read ONLY by the evaluation harness for scoring. Never passed to a tester, a tool, or a prompt.

b01.summary: Wall collision is skipped for thin walls (thickness < 0.3) when the body speed exceeds 45.

b02.summary: Position is advanced with the pre-update velocity (explicit Euler order), so energy drifts upward at large dt.

b03.summary: Penetration-recovery velocity scales as 1/dt^2, so tiny time steps inject huge velocity on contact.

b04.summary: Shallow contacts with a wall box corner (penetration < r/2) are ignored.

b05.summary: Effective restitution gains +0.15 when e > 0.9, so bounces create energy.

b06.summary: A resting-contact stabilizer adds a separating velocity to touching vertical contacts, pumping energy into stacks.

b07.summary: Impulse inverse masses are swapped when the mass ratio exceeds 4.

b08.summary: The controller force clamp is skipped when the body is within 1.5 of its waypoint.

b09.summary: The controller direction is normalised without a zero-length guard, giving NaN when the body sits exactly on its waypoint.

b10.summary: The right arena bound uses x > W instead of x > W - r for bodies with r > 0.8.
